yoddha.title_tag: Yoddha (2013) Marathi Action Drama | MK Studio Pune
yoddha.meta_desc: Watch Yoddha – a 2013 Marathi action drama by M.K. Dhumal & Prasad Inamdar. Stars Saurabh Gokhale & Priya Berde. Stream free on YouTube. MK Studio Pune.
yoddha.brief: Yoddha is a gripping 2013 Marathi action drama that asks a powerful question: what does it truly mean to be a warrior? When a hero rises not against a foreign enemy but against the evil hiding within his own family, the real battle begins. Directed by Prasad Inamdar and produced by M.K. Dhumal and Vijay Chaudhary under Shree Ganesh Movie Creations, the film stars Saurabh Gokhale in a fearless lead role as a man of principle fighting for justice in a decaying society. With Nagesh Bhosle, Priya Berde, and Sunil Godbole in pivotal supporting roles, Yoddha delivers high-stakes drama rooted in Marathi culture and values.
